image_description: Two hockey pucks displayed against a black background. The left puck features a white face with a red and orange graphic of a bear or mascot head and surrounding text. The right puck has a black face with a red circular logo containing stylized text and a silver/grey curved graphic below it. Both show the characteristic raised ridges on their side edges.

The objects appear solid and opaque with no signs of translucency or internal structure inconsistent with solid rubber.

While the base material is black, the faces are heavily decorated with white, red, and orange graphics. The 'matte black' description applies only to the unprinted side/edge, not the overall visual appearance of these specific branded pucks.
